newsitem.title: UK: Yorkshire Water indicated lower after H1.
newsitem.headline: Yorkshire Water indicated lower after H1.

text.p: Shares in Yorkshire Water were indicated 7p lower at 673p at 0815 GMT, after the company released its interim results, which included a dividend at the low end of analysts' forecasts.
Yorkshire reported pre-tax interim profits of 109.4 million stg, which was in the upper range of market expectations, but issued a dividend of 10.2p per share.

"The results are okay, but there's nothing special -- no share buyback, no special dividends and the (regular) dividend itself is a bit disappointing," said one marketmaker. "The shares have had a pretty good run."
Yorkshire shares have come off in recent sessions after having climbed 106p, or about 18 percent, during the past month to a five-month high set earlier this week.
